cfg_if::cfg_if! {
    if #[cfg(unix)] {
        mod unix;
        use unix as plat;
    } else {
        #[path = "win/mod.rs"]
        mod win;
        use win as plat;
    }
}

#[cfg(unix)]
#[path = "sys/unix.rs"]
mod imp;

#[cfg(windows)]
#[path = "sys/windows.rs"]
mod imp;

/// the data module lives elsewhere
#[path = "gen/data.rs"]
mod data;

#[cfg_attr(feature = "alt", path = "alt.rs")]
#[cfg_attr(not(feature = "alt"), path = "plain.rs")]
mod other;

mod local;

fn main() {
    imp::f();
    data::load();
    other::run();
    local::here();
    plat::start();
}
